transcript: Speaker A: 2026 lagbhag aadha saal beet gaya. Kya tum English ke teen naye shabd bhi seekh paye? Dekho, English seekhna mushkil nahi hai, mushkil hai shuru karna. Toh aaj shuru karo, English Seekho app download karo. Do hafte ka challenge lo, roz sirf 15 minute. Pehla hafta, experts ke video dekho. Spoken English show hai. Hindi mein samjha ke English bolna sikhate hain. Basic se start hoga. Hello, Thank you, Excuse me, yahan se. Chhote do-paanch minute ke video, itne aasan ki lagega ye toh mujhe bhi aa sakta hai. Dusra hafta, AI coach ke saath practice karo. 24 ghante available hain AI coach, subah 5 baje bhi, raat ke 12 baje bhi. Jo expert ke video mein seekha, woh AI coach ke saath bolke practice karo. Galat bologe, sudhaar dengi. Pronunciation galat hai, pakad lengi. Tense galat lagaya, bata dengi. 100 baar galat bolo, 100 baar sudhaar dengi. Hasengi nahi, kabhi judge nahi karengi, kabhi nahi bolengi 'itna bhi nahi aata tumhein'. Aur sabse badi baat, kisi stranger se baat nahi karni. Kisi ajnabi ke saamne galat English bolke sharmana nahi hai. Tum aur AI coach, bas. Private, safe, tumhari speed se. 14 din mein kya hoga? English perfect nahi hogi, jhoot nahi bolungi. Par itna hoga ki tum bol paoge. Bina ruke, bina dare, bina sharmaye. Aur wahi kaafi hai shuru karne ke liye. Expert sikhayein, AI coach ke saath practice karo. Trial sirf ek rupya. No bahana, sirf practice. English Seekho app download karo. [2026 is half over. Did you learn even three new English words? Starting is the hard part. Download English Seekho and take a 14-day challenge, 15 minutes daily. Week 1: watch short expert videos explaining English in Hindi. Week 2: practice speaking with a 24/7 AI coach who corrects your grammar and pronunciation privately without judgment. You will speak confidently in 14 days. Trial is just 1 rupee. Download now.] Speaker B: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text:
English Seekho [Learn English]
INSTALL NOW
Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority... [Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority...]
summary: An AI avatar challenges viewers to learn English in 14 days by practicing 15 minutes daily on the English Seekho app. The method combines expert Hindi-to-English videos with private AI coach practice. Viewers are urged to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.
